plans.idea: Centered strip: one wide text slot on the canvas's central axis, as in the original's centered stack, so the two-tone headline fills the full height and the tracked subline sits centered beneath it. A tiny minor slot is tucked in the corner because this ad has nothing else to place.

Left-anchored banner: the headline and its subline share a firm left edge at the margin and run left to right across most of the strip, filling the height so the headline is large and the text reads like a banner. A small minor slot sits at the far right end.

Edge-to-edge with deep vertical padding: a single full-width text slot with a larger margin, so the headline is set a little smaller but is ringed by even whitespace on all sides and centered as one calm line. A sliver of minor sits at the bottom-right corner.
